# Contributing

SUNavigator is in a feedback phase: the app is not being changed until users have tried it.

- Tried it? Use the [feedback form](https://github.com/cagdaskarabag/su_navigator/issues/new?template=feedback.yml). Say which version of SUNavigator and Splunk you run and which role you used.
- Found a defect? Open an issue with the steps. Check [docs/FEATURE_STATUS.md](../docs/FEATURE_STATUS.md) first; known problems are listed there.
- Security problem? Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not a public issue.
- Code changes: open an issue first. A pull request needs the unit tests to pass: `cd tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s unit -t .`

The project is licensed under Apache-2.0. Do not add data, screenshots or names from products you are not licensed to share.
